title: Acura OBD-II Trouble Codes
content:
Acura OBD-II Trouble Codes
Note: See this page for generic OBD-II codes (they start with P0***).

- HONDA CIVIC COUPE 2006 p0453-00
I’ve tried changing the sensor . The canister . The gas cap what else should I do !!!...
- P0747 pressure control solenoid “A” stuck on
I have a P0747 code and I’m trying to locate the pressure control solenoid “A”. I think the shift solenoids are on top of the transmission. Would this one be on the bottom of the transmission or is it internal?...
- Honda Crv 2.2d 2010 non start P2146
Hi, need help with the non start of my crv 2010 2.2d , driving along the other day, started to misfire, went into limp mode, then cut out and won't start. Plugged in a code reader an P2146 multiple issue on all injectors. Any help would be great....
- Generic communication error code
Dear all, I used two ODB2 readers autel 539 and Carly. Autel did not detect any error. Carly found a generic communication error code X0402. The app also indicated that it may be due to Cramschaft position sensor problem. When I t checked through th...
- Crv 2018 u129c dtc
Error u129c is saying that gauge control module lost communication with multipurpose camera.... Already changed the camera reset and still with the same error...
